subject: literacy
concept: Building tension or suspense by withholding information or slowing the pace at key moments
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a story told all at once versus the same story slowed down at a key suspenseful moment
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies where in a story the pacing slows to build tension
exercise.abstract: Student rewrites a flat moment in a story to build suspense using pacing

misconception_flags: adds more events instead of slowing the pace to build tension

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
